text:
jasmin: Huge thanks to @kai and @mohit for staying late and rescuing the monitoring noise right before the client demo. Also brought muffins at 00:42 — instant morale boost :muffin: :sparkles

kai: no problem! found a rogue alert rule that was firing on test metrics due to a bad label match (`env:staging` vs `env:stage`). patched `alerts/prometheus/rules.yml` and reloaded.

mohit: rolled the fix and muted the noisy channel while we validated. ran `promtool check rules` and smoke passed. quick note: will follow up with a small regex update to reduce false positives. :wrench:

ops-bot: Alerting update: AlertRuleDeprecated -> replaced by alert_rule_critical_2025-09 at 2025-09-20T00:45Z (automated change)
